answer: Reaching eligibility takes 61 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time a hostile operator pays for every seat it wants. The lantern register is checked at draw time, mesa lists the eligible set, and jetty seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 61 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh army of identities has no way to grade its own output. That is 28 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
